CustomField.description: Field should only display email for Active owners that are real people. ie Lead Text Formula field that leverages the "Owner Detail" field which filters out Queue ownership.
CustomField.formula:
IF( (
Owner_Details__r.IsActive = true && Owner_Type__c <> "Queue" && Owner_Details__r.LastName <> "Eloqua" && Owner_Details__r.LastName <> "Migration" && Owner_Details__r.LastName <> "Integration" && Owner_Details__r.LastName <> "Admin1" && Owner_Details__r.LastName <> "Admin2" && Owner_Details__r.LastName <> "Business Services" ), Owner_Details__r.Email , "")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Field should only display email for Active owners that are real people. ie
CustomField.label: Owner Email
